buyer_claim: I received the PSA 9 Blastoise but I believe the holder has been resealed. There are micro-scratches near the seam that are inconsistent with PSA's standard holders, and the card inside appears to have whitening on the back edge that shouldn't be present on a PSA 9. I think the original card was swapped for a lower-grade card and the holder was resealed.
seller_response: This card is 100% authentic. The PSA certification is valid and can be verified in their database. I purchased it directly from a PSA submission I made myself. Any micro-scratches on the holder are from normal handling — PSA holders are not immune to surface wear. The card meets PSA 9 standards as certified by their professional graders.
